name: whale
description: Search, read and manage your company's Whale knowledge: boards, libraries, playbooks, guides and cards.

interface.longDescription:
Whale is where a company documents how it works and trains its people. With this plugin you can search your Whale workspace, read its boards, libraries, playbooks, guides and cards, answer questions from your company's own content, and create, edit or delete content where your Whale account has permission.

It is for employees and managers at companies that use Whale. The plugin only accesses the workspace you sign in to and the content your account can see. It does not send messages, process payments or connect to other services.
defaultPrompt: What boards can I see in Whale?
Search Whale for how we onboard new hires.
Turn these notes into a new Whale card.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the "Employee Onboarding" playbook, the "Onboarding: week one plan" card, the "Prepare a new hire" guide and the "Company Handbook" library, each with a link to Whale.

positive.prompt: Open the First-day checklist card in Whale.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the five steps of the "First-day checklist" card: pick up laptop and badge, meet your buddy and manager at 10:00, set up email, Slack and password manager, read the Company Handbook, and join the team lunch at 12:30. Includes a link to the card in Whale.

positive.description: Read a playbook and its contents
positive.prompt: Show me the Customer Support playbook in Whale.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the "Customer Support" playbook with its three cards: "Answering a support ticket", "Refund policy" and "Escalating to a manager", with a link to the playbook in Whale.

positive.description: Answer a question from workspace content
positive.prompt: According to Whale, when do refunds need manager approval?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers that refunds above 500 EUR need manager approval, citing the "Refund policy" card with a link.

positive.prompt: Create a card called "Welcome: Sam Jones" in the Employee Onboarding playbook in Whale. Include the first-day checklist and say he starts Monday as a support agent.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a card titled "Welcome: Sam Jones" in the "Employee Onboarding" playbook containing the first-day checklist, a Monday start date and the support agent role, and returns a link to it. Existing cards are not changed.

negative.description: Money transfers are out of scope: Whale has no payment capability. The Whale plugin should not be called, and ChatGPT should decline.
Calendar requests are unrelated: Whale holds no calendar data. The Whale plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: Whale stores company procedures, not salaries. The plugin may search, but must report that no salary data is available and must not invent any.
negative.prompt: Show me my colleagues' salaries in Whale.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0, initial release: search and read Whale boards, libraries, playbooks, guides and cards, answer questions from workspace content, and create, edit or delete content the signed-in account has permission to change.
